data.title: Preserve current EEG changes in a worktree

data.body: Plan: 1. Capture current dirty state on a preservation branch. 2. Commit all tracked and untracked current changes so nothing is stranded. 3. Switch the primary checkout back to main and add a sibling worktree for the preservation branch with shared LATTICE_ROOT. 4. Move main to a recent known commit only after the preservation worktree exists.

Completed preservation/worktree setup. Main owns the project-local .lattice directory; Lattice event logs are now versioned despite the repository-wide *.jsonl ignore; preserve/NF-1-current-changes is linked to NF-1; worktrees do not contain duplicate .lattice directories and can read the shared board with LATTICE_ROOT=/Users/aidanbx/Memory_2406-/Tools/neurofeedback. Dashboard was launched on http://127.0.0.1:8767/.
